_doc: AUDIENCE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22): every Ultrastable system builds and holds a returning audience: breadth, depth and diversity of content, fresh content on a clock, promotion of that content, and measured return. Read by seed/scripts/audience.py (the engine every system carries) through foundation/audience.py (python3 -m foundation audience --check|--run [--apply]|--probe METRIC). A breach files Q-AUD-<metric> with the metric as closing probe; a freshness breach also runs the section's producer once a day (fresh-content loop). Sources: CREDITS.md, rows marked AUDIENCE-1.
consent: Promotion goes only to the owner's and the project's own accounts through social/gate.json and the THOUGHT-1 consent record; no cold messages to individuals; opt-outs and platform rules always win (outreach/gate.json).
hook: Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable; Practical Solutions is an example

metrics.remedy: a section that published nothing in the window: run its producer, or give it one
one section carries nearly everything: publish in the quiet sections (papers, posts) before adding to the loud one
new items are thin: lead each with what changed and why it matters, from the record that produced it
too little new content: run the producers on their clocks (research weekly, thought every 3 days, reach daily)
nothing new recently: the fresh-content loop runs the stale section's producer
new items with no post: thought and reach queue a post per new paper and change within the gate's caps
readers look but do not act: put the hook (quiz, tool, live result) on the pages they land on and make finishing it rewarding
readers leave after one page: link each page to the next related one (related papers, the live record behind a claim)
one page takes all the views: surface the other sections from it
no one polls the feeds: advertise /research.atom and /progress.atom on every page and post, and ping hubs on publish
aggregator subscribers fell: check the feeds still validate and still carry fresh entries
followers fell: check the posting loop ran, the posts carried the hook and no guard blocked them
few readers come back to inner pages on their own: give each page a stable link worth keeping and a feed for what changes on it

hooks.why: a reader tests what they believe and sees their own result; finishing it is the engagement
the reader's own idea is turned into a system plan question by question
